content.question: In association problems, what does support measure?
options: How popular an itemset is, i.e. the frequency of the itemset within the dataset
The conditional probability of seeing the consequent given the antecedent
The increase of the probability of the consequent when the antecedent is present
How well the model explains the variance of the outcome
content.answer: How popular an itemset is, i.e. the frequency of the itemset within the dataset
